title: CULTURE3D: A Large-Scale and Diverse Dataset of Cultural Landmarks and Terrains for Gaussian-Based Scene Rendering
reasoning: The paper is focused on 3D reconstruction and Gaussian Splatting for cultural heritage sites. While it includes 'religious sites' as a category of the data used for the benchmark, the evaluation is purely technical (measuring image reconstruction metrics like PSNR and SSIM) and does not involve assessing or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
